milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-T3 OmniRoute installed CLI/version compatibility test
milestoneContract.objective: Verify read-only on the target machine that the installed OmniRoute matches config/omniroute-policy.json (identity, license, repository, Node engines range, launcher location, local-only endpoint) without starting it, closing the CLI/version part of the corresponding target-machine pending item, without touching protected files or any pending package scope.
requirements: [V6-PKG-T3-OMNIROUTE-INSTALL-COMPAT-2026-09-29 founderAuthorization.rule] Founder rule 2026-09-29: A blocked/review-pending package blocks ONLY its own dependency lane; implement the next independent eligible package in an isolated branch, validate, checkpoint, commit, prepare the frozen review bundle, mark it REVIEW_PENDING if Codex is unavailable, and continue; never modify a pending package's branch, bundle, clone, evidence or cycle state.

[V6-PKG-T3-OMNIROUTE-INSTALL-COMPAT-2026-09-29 founderAuthorization.constraint] Tests and non-protected documentation only; read-only checks; no protected file, no pending package scope, no merge; OmniRoute is not started.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

The selftest only reads package metadata, resolves the launcher and probes the policy endpoint on an allowed local host; it never starts OmniRoute, never contacts a non-local host and reports a stopped endpoint as NOT_RUNNING; without OmniRoute it skips honestly.
An engines range the helper cannot parse is reported UNKNOWN and never counted as compatible.
The target-machine pending document states precisely what is verified and that provider routing remains pending; no protected file changes and no existing test, validator or policy is weakened.
mandatoryFailureCases: OmniRoute started or a non-local host contacted by the test
an unknown engines range treated as compatible
a protected file or pending package scope changed

previousFindingLedger.expected: Reject a disallowed endpoint before any network request.
previousFindingLedger.observed: The host check only records FAIL; the next statement unconditionally calls probe(policy.endpoint), which invokes http.get for the rejected host.
previousFindingLedger.blockerReason: The newly introduced selftest violates the explicit requirement never to contact a non-local host. Reporting failure after issuing the request does not enforce that boundary.
previousFindingLedger.remediationAcceptance: Gate probing on successful endpoint validation and add a regression test proving that a disallowed host causes zero network calls.

steps: Extract and evaluate the satisfies function from the reviewed git object in memory.

previousFindingLedger.expected: A range containing unsupported or malformed syntax is reported UNKNOWN and never counted as compatible.
previousFindingLedger.observed: Short-circuiting some/every skips unsupported tokens, and filtering empty alternatives discards malformed branches. Consequently partially unsupported or malformed ranges can return true and produce nodeEngine=PASS.
previousFindingLedger.blockerReason: The helper violates an explicit acceptance criterion and mandatory failure case; the supplied test covers only a standalone unsupported expression.
previousFindingLedger.remediationAcceptance: Validate the complete range syntax before evaluating compatibility. Add regression coverage for unsupported expressions in otherwise matching alternatives, unsupported tokens after a false comparator, and empty alternatives; each must return UNKNOWN.
